title: Inventory update
statementMd:
Apply a list of `[item, delta]` updates to the `stock` dict (missing items start at 0). Remove items whose quantity becomes 0 or less. Return the new dict and do not mutate the input.

**Example:** `apply_updates({"a": 2}, [["a", 1], ["b", 3]])` returns `{"a": 3, "b": 3}`.
